_comment: Maps feature areas to file patterns and metadata. The bootstrap workflow uses this to chunk the codebase into Claude-sized bites and generate per-feature product guides.
_instructions: Update glob patterns to match your actual directory structure. Each feature area gets its own Claude call and its own Guru card.

features.name: Scanner & Ticket Analysis
features.description: The core scanning engine that processes Zendesk tickets through multi-phase LLM pipelines for classification and NLP analysis.
features.guide_focus: What the scanner does, how scans are triggered, what outputs it produces, how to interpret scan results

features.name: Voice of Customer (VOC) Pipeline
features.description: Multi-agent analysis pipeline that produces confirmed findings with confidence tiering from ticket data.
features.audience: CX Operations leads reviewing VOC reports
features.guide_focus: How VOC analysis works, what a VOC report contains, confidence tiers, how to action findings

features.name: EWMA Watchlist Engine
features.description: Exponentially weighted moving average engine that monitors ticket volume trends and surfaces alerts for anomalous patterns.
features.audience: CX Operations analysts monitoring real-time trends
features.guide_focus: What the watchlist tracks, how EWMA thresholds work, how alerts surface, how to configure sensitivity

features.name: Guru Knowledge Base Integration
features.description: Integration layer for analyzing, generating, and managing Guru KB cards including card graph building and content generation.
features.audience: Enablement and CX Operations teams managing knowledge bases
features.guide_focus: How Guru analysis works, card graph visualization, content generation workflow, KB health metrics

features.name: Zendesk Source Monitor
features.description: Monitors Zendesk data sources for availability, freshness, and schema changes.
features.audience: CX Operations analysts and platform administrators
features.guide_focus: What sources are monitored, how freshness is tracked, what alerts indicate, troubleshooting stale data

features.name: Data Warehouse & Storage
features.description: Local data warehouse layer handling ticket data persistence, caching, and query interfaces.
features.guide_focus: Data retention, storage architecture, how to query historical data, cache management

features.name: Dual-Provider AI Architecture
features.description: Task-routed architecture using Gemini for PHI-certified NLP and Claude for non-PHI operations including content generation and analysis.
features.guide_focus: Which AI handles what, PHI routing logic, model selection, how tool definitions work

features.name: Platform Core & Settings
features.description: Core platform infrastructure including settings management, auto-update system, and UI framework.
features.guide_focus: Getting started, configuration, updates, general navigation

features.name: GitHub Integration
features.description: GitHub wiring for issue tracking, deployment coordination, and development workflow integration.
features.guide_focus: What GitHub integration provides, how issues flow, deployment coordination

global_context.product_type: PySide6 desktop analytics platform for CX operations intelligence
global_context.primary_users: CX Operations analysts, managers, and enablement teams at Alma
